title: TC-E2E-009: backward audit traceability from outcome to originating signal (approved sandbox)
risk: Nobody can explain a completed customer-visible action: the audit trail is assembled from memory, a link is missing, or a tampered evidence row is accepted as proof.
preconditions: run_id=RUN-E2E-LIVE-TRACE, case_id=E2E-LIVE-TRACE, worker=w-biz-e2e-live; one sandbox run that creates a real sandbox order/message is completed first
the sandbox audit export for that run is fetched read-only and the sandbox verification facility (or the documented hash fields) is available for the walk

inputs.audit_export: read-only sandbox audit trail for the run
inputs.negative_probe: case-local copy of the chain with one tampered payload

steps.expected: the run completes against the sandbox and its sandbox order/message id is recorded with the run_id

steps.action: Fetch the sandbox audit trail read-only
steps.expected: the export contains the run entries for signal, context, decision, authority verdict, execution, evidence and outcome, all carrying the same run_id

steps.action: Walk the chain backward on live records
steps.expected: outcome -> evidence -> execution -> decision -> context -> signal resolves with the sandbox ids, ending at the sandbox inbound event id
the sandbox hash fields or the sandbox verification endpoint confirm the chain for the run with no unchained entry

steps.action: Probe a broken link without touching the sandbox
steps.expected: the case-local chain copy with one tampered payload fails verification and the broken link is reported, while the sandbox rows themselves are left untouched

steps.action: Confirm nothing was reconstructed from memory
steps.expected: the walk is repeated from the exported rows alone and reproduces the identical chain, with the sandbox artefacts retained

assertions: every live walk hop resolves to a sandbox audit row with the identical run_id and ends at the real sandbox signal id
the live chain verifies with the sandbox hash fields and the failed link inside the case-local copy is detected rather than hidden

no sandbox immutable audit row was modified or deleted by the probe — the provider test sink is the oracle for every denied or refused step: its call log for the run stays empty, no provider id is manufactured for the attempt, and the audit entry records the refusal instead (the probe performs no provider mutation)
the live trace is reproducible from the export after the run, so the case passes on the persisted chain rather than on an in-session view
forbidden: mutating or deleting sandbox audit/evidence rows to exercise the negative probe
reporting a complete live trace while a stage entry is missing from the sandbox audit export
evidence: read-only sandbox audit export for the run with row ids and hashes
sandbox chain verification result plus the case-local broken-link report
the sandbox order/message id that anchors the outcome end of the chain
cleanup: Retire the sandbox artefacts created by this run through the supported sandbox APIs (cancel/withdraw the created cart, campaign, case and voucher references); delete nothing immutable — sent messages, provider receipts and audit rows are retained and reported as non-deletable rather than pretending they were unsent
automation: Real code under test: skill registry row, authority guard/PEP, input validator, deadline and retry loop, effect_key reservation + reconciliation, evidence/audit writer. Substituted boundary: the external adapter (in-memory for offline, approved sandbox for live). Frozen clock 2026-01-15T10:00:00Z; all waits are condition/deadline waits on the engine's virtual clock, never sleep. Same reader against the sandbox audit trail; the broken-link probe runs on the case's own chain copy so no sandbox row is mutated.
prerequisites: ASM-001 approved connector lock is present (LIVE_CONNECTORS_LOCK points at the approved connector list) — without it this case is SKIP_ASM_001, never PASS

Per-case sandbox authorization: the run_id of this case is registered in the approved sandbox allowlist with its sandbox tenant/customer/SKU mapping before execution; credentials live outside the repository (env.local) and are never printed in evidence
The sandbox audit trail is readable for the run (API or approved export) and exposes row hashes; without a readable audit trail the case is BLOCKED_PREREQUISITE and no PASS is claimed
The broken-link probe uses the case's own chain copy; sandbox immutable audit rows are never modified
